title: Guesses are committed to the repository as one JSON file each, so public repositories publish them
why: Shared history lets reviewers, CI, and later sessions see the same decisions; one file per guess avoids merge conflicts
alternatives: Keep the ledger local and gitignored by default

resolution.decision: Guesses are committed to the repository as one JSON file each, so public repositories publish them
resolution.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). Pull request summaries, CI checks, and shared memory need the committed ledger. Projects that want it private can gitignore .guesswork/, now documented.
